name: smwpatches-sprites-become-coins-by-goal-sphere-v1
title: Sprites Become Coins by Goal Sphere v1.1
description:
All enemies turn into coins when the goal sphere is acquired.
You can also set whether the player moves after acquiring the goal sphere or stops on the spot after landing.
You can also set whether the sprite in your hand when you acquire a Goal Sphere will be changed into a coin or an item.
